g.title: OX03
g.text: OX-03 | ESTABLISH A SINGLE SCENE DECISION CONTRACT
Behavior board • approval status and fingerprints: cycle 142 plan and roadmap

g.title: selected
g.text: One authoritative instant is used for reading, composition,

g.title: presentation
g.text: Evaluates the selected instant once; creates the reading

g.title: foreground
g.text: Remain tied to the same selected instant
Independent facts and source-time disclosure stay unchanged

g.title: reading
g.text: Supplied values keep their field evidence and source times

g.title: resolver
g.text: Maps weather evidence and time inputs into typed decisions

g.title: evidence
g.text: MISSING / EMPTY: do not imply a supplied condition
ELIGIBLE CARRIED: preserve its original source time
No plausibility correction or new weather inference

g.title: primary
g.text: from this reading and selected instant

g.title: fallback
g.text: Use the same reading and zone to obtain

g.title: composition
g.text: Sky · clouds · precipitation · cues · treatment · layer order

g.title: renderer
g.text: Draws the decisions it receives; does not reinterpret

g.title: frame
g.text: Reading fallback matches the established composition output
for the same input and selected instant

g.title: acceptance
g.text: Source-of-truth decisions are made at the reading → composition boundary
Both active routes match for covered First City states
With visible cloud decisions, rain begins at the cloud base
Without visible clouds, preserve the no-cloud rain baseline
Scoped code proof and installed visuals where the plan requires them

g.title: scope
g.text: No timeline, forecast fact, selection, or layout redesign
No app-wide accessibility or system acceptance

g.title: outside
g.text: The proposed Living Urban Park scene-engine concept motivates this shared decision seam; OX-03 keeps the current First City baseline
Cloud-origin rain is the correction only where visible cloud decisions already exist; no-cloud carried rain keeps the established field origin
No cloud cover is inferred; no rain support or coverage rule changes
Sun/Moon cue appearance is outside review; the fixed lunar shadow is not approved as phase artwork
Park artwork, in-scene readouts, adoption of the draft spec, and default-vs-selectable choice are not approved here
View-only state renderer stays separate while reachability is unverified; Fixture / Time Lab previews stay separate
Unknown-state policy, depth ordering, and reusable world support remain later slices
